responsibility: Core implementation of the shared code-entry handler base used by all BRIG code-section translators. It provides the common machinery for turning BRIG operands, code references, constants, vectors, addresses, and type conversions into GCC trees; includes reusable vector-element visitor logic; performs fp16/ftz helper lowering and integer extension utilities; and centralizes operand building, temporary creation, and output-assignment support that specialized instruction and directive handlers depend on.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable behavior of the shared code-entry handler framework declared in brig-code-entry-handler.h: it implements operand/code-reference lowering, vector-element visitor traversal, fp16/flush helper expansion, and integer-extension utilities used by concrete handlers.
